theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Consumer Staples (+2.10%) and Communication Svcs (+1.90%) led the market today, while Technology (-1.51%) and Energy (-1.41%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.63%, defensives +1.15%, and value/cyclicals +0.27% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. That shows up at the index level too: the blue-chip Dow gained +1.03% while the tech-heavy Nasdaq fell -0.22%, a wide enough gap to matter. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.20%. The VIX fell 2.46% to 18.21, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.74% to $4,019.80, crude oil was little changed at $82.01, and bitcoin gained 0.65% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
